name: knowledge-work-plugins
description: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
one_liner: Ready-made add-ons that turn a general AI assistant into a specialist for a particular job, like legal review or financial reporting, with the tools and habits that role actually needs.
buyer: A boutique consulting or ops firm that wants to offer clients an AI assistant pre-configured for their exact industry, instead of a generic chatbot.
business_use_cases: An accounting firm packages a custom plugin bundle that knows its clients' reporting formats and sells it as part of a retainer.
An HR consultancy builds a plugin that handles intake and policy questions in its house style, then resells the setup to other small HR teams.
A real estate brokerage configures a plugin for lease abstraction and listing write-ups, saving junior staff hours per week.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell industry-specific plugin bundles (legal, accounting, real estate) as a setup-and-support service.
Run workshops or a course teaching firms how to build their own plugins on this framework.

steal_this: Pick one underserved profession (e.g. independent insurance brokers), build one solid plugin for their exact workflow this weekend, and sell it directly to a handful of firms.
